description: pkix-path/src/lib.rs has three private helper functions (cert_is_ca, has_key_cert_sign, cert_path_len_constraint) that each iterate over cert.tbs_certificate.extensions searching for a specific OID. All three duplicate the same pattern: get the extensions slice, iterate, match OID, parse with from_der. A private helper find_extension(cert, oid) -> Option<&Extension> would remove the duplication and make each function a two-liner. This also affects pkix-chain-simple which repeats the same pattern for BasicConstraints and KeyUsage. The duplication is maintenance burden: a change to extension iteration (e.g., using x509-cert's extension accessor API) must be applied in five places.
title: Repeated extension OID scan in cert_is_ca, has_key_cert_sign, cert_path_len_constraint
